---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new workflow
labels: enhancement
---

## Is this feature related to a problem?
Describe the workflow limitation or user need.

## Proposed solution
Describe the behavior you would like, including relevant inputs and outputs.

## Engineering basis (if applicable)
Provide the reference, edition, page/table, manufacturer source, or explain that this is a proposed engineering decision. Do not present screening as validated design verification.

## Alternatives considered
Describe any alternatives or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context
Add screenshots, sample data that you are licensed to share, or other context. Do not include customer-identifying reports or proprietary material.
